headline: Anthropic's junior share of technical hires fell from 27% to 9%, per its study
body: An **Anthropic** study says the share of junior-level employees in technical departments slipped from 21% to 14% since early 2025. It says the junior share of technical hires fell faster, from 27% to 9%. By August, interactive AI agent hours outnumbered employees' six to one.
note: Junior technical roles are where future specialists are trained, so a slowdown there deserves a closer look. Anthropic points to its agents as the reason, and the study itself admits the company is a special case.

figure.label: junior share of Anthropic's technical hires, per its study

evidence.text: By August interactive AI agent hours outnumbered employees’ six to one.
Figure 1 shows that the share of junior-level employees in technical departments at Anthropic slipped from 21% to 14% since early 2025.
The proportion of junior technical hires fell even faster, from 27% to 9%.
Anthropic points to the growing capability of its AI agents as the reason.
The study itself admits that Anthropic is a special case, though.
